notes:
Company snapshot: SaaS provider that sells customer support workflow tools to mid-size retailers. Heavy Zendesk footprint (currently on Zendesk Suite). Primary ask: accurate, short ticket/email summarization + reliable auto-tagging to drive macros and triggers in Zendesk. Also want low-latency agent-assist snippets in the agent sidebar for escalations and live chats.

Discovery call (2025-01-22):
- Met with CTO (A. Morales), Head of Ops (L. Jensen), and Product lead (S. Kapoor).
- Quote from CTO: "We need summaries that our agents can trust — 3 lines max, with tag suggestions. If it misses, agent loses trust instantly."
- Current pain: long average handle time (AHT) due to manual triage; missed SLAs during promotions/spikes.

Requirements (call notes):
- Primary workflows: inbound email/ticket triage, macro suggestion, auto-tagging for routing, nightly batch summarization for backlog.
- Integrations: Zendesk triggers/macros, Freshdesk pilot in two pilot accounts. Wants OAuth app + sandbox instance install.
- Outputs needed per ticket: 1) TL;DR summary (<= 40 words), 2) 1-3 suggested tags (with confidence), 3) suggested macros or reply templates, 4) priority score (0-100).
- Latency targets: agent-assist suggestions streamed within ~300-500ms for chat; synchronous summarization OK at 3-12s for email async flows.
- Throughput: baseline 500 tickets/hour, peak 7k tickets/hour during promos (spike reliability is critical).
- Cost sensitivity: wants to cap token spend per summary; open to batching/caching suggestions.
- Model preference: open models for POC; evaluate quantized/reduced models for Dedicated if accuracy holds.
- Fallback policy: automatic downgrade to smaller model during sustained spikes; graceful degrade to headline-only summary when under duress.

Security & compliance path:
- Needs SOC2 Type II evidence; EU data residency for EU customers (retain EU tickets on EU region).
- KMS integration preferred for encryption of PII.
- Audit logs required for agent edits and model prompts.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: sandbox Zendesk install + sample ticket export (30k anonymized tickets).
- Week 1: baseline eval w/ hosted API, run 2 summarization pipelines (streaming & batch).
- Week 2: integrate auto-tagging into triggers, A/B test on 10% traffic. Monitor accuracy and false positives.
- Week 3: stress test for promo spike template (simulate 7k tix/hr), validate fallback routing + latency.

Recent activity & action items (2025-01-24 -> 2025-02-04):
- 2025-01-24: Sent POC checklist + data export instructions (Maya). Gmail thread created.
- 2025-01-28: Security shared preliminary questionnaire; Cascade Clarify returned 80% answered.
- 2025-02-01: SE session (Diego) demoed sample summaries vs. current agent notes. Team liked condensed TL;DR but asked for better entity extraction for product SKUs.
- 2025-02-03: Legal asked for retention clause for EU; Maya escalated to Solutions Legal.
- 2025-02-04: Confirmed POC kickoff 2025-02-10 pending sandbox credentials.

Notes & sales tips:
- Emphasize Redwood's dedicated capacity + fallback models for spike reliability. Stress batching + cache recommendations to hit cost targets.
- Offer pre-built Zendesk app manifest and a quick install path to shorten internal review.
- Show audit logging + KMS integration details early. Provide SOC2 evidence snapshot.
- Prepare a short eval script: precision/recall on tags, average TL;DR compression ratio, end-to-end latency under load.
